name: Delete an Alias
description: Delete an Alias Delete an Alias with the specified ID. DELETE /v2/aliases/{aliasId}
context:
DELETE /v2/aliases/{aliasId}
Delete an Alias with the specified ID.
Required: aliasId (path) — The ID or alias that will be removed
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

name: Get an Alias
description: Get an Alias Retrieves an Alias for the given host name or alias ID. GET /v4/aliases/{idOrAlias}
context:
GET /v4/aliases/{idOrAlias}
Retrieves an Alias for the given host name or alias ID.
Required: idOrAlias (path) — The alias or alias ID to be retrieved
Optional: from (query) — Get the alias only if it was created after the provided timestamp; projectId (query) — Get the alias only if it is assigned to the provided project ID; since (query) — Get the alias only if it was created after this JavaScript timestamp; until (query) — Get the alias only if it was created before this JavaScript timestamp; teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

name: List aliases
description: List aliases Retrieves a list of aliases for the authenticated User or Team. GET /v4/aliases
context:
GET /v4/aliases
Retrieves a list of aliases for the authenticated User or Team. When `domain` is provided, only aliases for that domain will be returned. When `projectId` is provided, it will only return the given project aliases.
Optional: domain (query) — Get only aliases of the given domain name; from (query) — Get only aliases created after the provided timestamp; limit (query) — Maximum number of aliases to list from a request; projectId (query) — Filter aliases from the given `projectId`; since (query) — Get aliases created after this JavaScript timestamp; until (query) — Get aliases created before this JavaScript timestamp; rollbackDeploymentId (query) — Get aliases that would be rolled back for the given deployment; teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.

name: Update the protection bypass for a URL
description: Update the protection bypass for a URL Update the protection bypass for the alias or deployment URL (used for user access & comment access for deployments). PATCH /aliases/{id}/protection-bypass
context:
PATCH /aliases/{id}/protection-bypass
Update the protection bypass for the alias or deployment URL (used for user access & comment access for deployments). Used as shareable links and user scoped access for Vercel Authentication and also to allow external (logged in) people to comment on previews for Preview Comments (next-live-mode).
Required: id (path) — The alias or deployment ID
Optional: teamId (query) — The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.; slug (query) — The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.; body (body)
